parent_objective: audit no-rollout off-track repair panel preflight before execution design
blocked_by: need repair panel preflight audit before measured execution design
supersedes: direct repair panel execution design after M1721

public_gates: M1722 must audit M1721 subset counts source/task/profile/variant coverage contract checks and guardrails
M1722 must decide whether repair panel execution design is admitted
M1722 must not execute rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1722 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-rollout repair panel metadata before execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if repair panel result class failed
stop if selected base spec count or T4/T5 split is wrong
stop if contract or guardrail checks fail
fallback_plan: route to materialization repair if preflight failed
route to measured execution design if preflight passes
route to branch synthesis if repair panel path becomes underdefined

admission_evidence: M1721 materialized no-rollout repair panel metadata
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1722 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up measured execution design manifest
next_stage_criteria: execution design admission decision is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1722 audits task repair metadata and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must keep L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset controls as controls only
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight fails, route to repair or source-distribution redesign rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1721 can be audited as a clean no-rollout off-track repair panel preflight and routed to execution design.
success_criteria: next repair panel execution design route is explicit
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to profile ranking
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit

decision_rule: M1722 passes if it audits M1721 and routes to repair panel execution design or repair without overclaiming.
